CPU.recipe: original online F/H single fit no refit

CT.reuse: five existing audited same-T/U CT caches, full-T U predictions

baseline_graph: V80 + original V85 -> original V90 -> original V100 with same-T/U CT
candidate_graph: V80 + C where C=0.5*(original V85+grouped V85) -> original V90 -> original V100 with same-T/U CT

meta.V90: fit-only five seed42 meta folds, grid 0..1 step .05, same tie-break, U five-prediction mean
meta.V100: fit-only five seed42 meta folds OOF, full T mid-ECDF and CT grid 0..0.5 step .025 for U, lower-weight tie-break

cache_gate: 600 complete source/model/row audited CPU atoms and five directly audited CT caches before any outer U scoring
score_gate: paired outer pooled candidate AUC > faithful baseline and positive in all 5 U blocks
submission_gate: score_gate + independent verification + full-data frozen prediction and CSV integrity + CLI one-time COMPLETE
